title: A Transformer-Based Delta Expression Encoder for Psilocybin Transcriptional Response: Architecture, Representations, and Biological Validation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding why individuals respond differently to psilocybin requires modeling the drug's transcriptional perturbation signature at the cell-type level. I present a Transformer-based delta expression encoder that learns to classify differential gene expression status - upregulated, downregulated, or neutral - from single-nucleus RNA-sequencing data, without supervision from pathway annotations or prior biological knowledge. The model is trained on pseudobulk profiles from 623 examples spanning 18 cell types, 2 drug conditions, and 6 timepoints derived from the Liao et al. 2025 dataset, and achieves 69.4% weighted classification accuracy. Three principal findings are reported, alongside one direct test of a published hypothesis that returned a result inconsistent with that hypothesis. translated_title: 一种基于Transformer的裸盖菇素转录响应差值表达编码器：架构、表征与生物学验证
translated_abstract: 理解个体对裸盖菇素响应差异的原因，需要在细胞类型层面建模该药物的转录扰动特征。本文提出了一种基于Transformer的差值表达编码器，它能够从单细胞核RNA测序数据中学习分类差异基因表达状态——上调、下调或中性——而无需依赖通路注释或先验生物学知识的监督。该模型在来自Liao等人2025年数据集的623个样本的伪批量表达谱上训练，涵盖18种细胞类型、2种药物条件和6个时间点，达到了69.4%的加权分类准确率。论文报告了三项主要发现，其中包括对一项已发表假设的直接检验，其结果与该假设不一致。首先，各细胞类型的分类准确率从28.3%（L2/3 IT，一种主要表达HTR2A的裸盖菇素靶点）到99.6%（内皮细胞）不等。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种无需先验生物学知识的基于Transformer的差值表达编码器，可从单细胞核RNA测序数据中分类裸盖菇素诱导的差异基因表达状态，在18种细胞类型上达到69.4%的加权准确率，并揭示了从28.3%到99.6%的显著细胞类型特异性分类差异。
en_tdlr: A Transformer-based delta expression encoder that classifies psilocybin-induced differential gene expression from single-nucleus RNA-seq data without prior biological knowledge, achieving 69.4% weighted accuracy across 18 cell types with per-cell-type performance ranging from 28.3% to 99.6%.
